name: Obsidian 1
description: Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Obsidian 1 was the lead TIE/ln starfighter of the Galactic Empire's Obsidian Squadron. Piloted by Civé Rashon, who operated under the call sign "Howlrunner" and the designation OS-72-1, Obsidian 1 at one point flew over Cloud City on the planet Bespin.
